scenes.narration: Old networks relied on one expensive private line. Cheaper links sat unused. S D W A N uses every link at once.

scenes.heading: The smart highway
scenes.narration: Think of a highway system that watches the traffic. Control is centralised, so policy is set in one place. It can use M P L S, broadband and L T E together. It picks the best path for each application. If a link degrades, traffic moves automatically.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. S D W A N uses many links at once. Policy is set centrally. Traffic moves to the best path. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva SD-WAN lab.
